units.source_text: 種種此類言語縈迴心中，但我只是用手帕擦著臉上的汗，笑著說：「冷汗，冷汗。」

en.t: All sorts of words like these circled in my mind, but I merely wiped the sweat from my face with a handkerchief and laughed, saying, "Cold sweat, cold sweat."

units.source_text: 然而，從那時起，我好像萌生了「世人不就是個人嗎？」這種略帶思想性的觀念。

en.t: Yet from that time on, I seem to have developed a somewhat philosophical notion: "Isn't society just an individual?"

units.source_text: 自從開始認為「世人就是個人」之後，跟以往比，我多少能夠按照自己的意志行事了。

en.t: After I began to think that "society is an individual," I became somewhat more able than before to act according to my own will.

units.source_text: 借靜子的話來說，我變得有些任性，不再那麼戰戰兢兢了。

en.t: To borrow Shizuko's words, I became somewhat selfish and was no longer so timid.

units.source_text: 再套用靜子的話，就是我變得非常吝嗇。

en.t: To borrow Shizuko's words again, I had become extremely stingy.

units.source_text: 連茂子也說，我不像以往那麼疼愛她了。

en.t: Even Shigeko said that I no longer doted on her as much as I used to.
